description: Codex trust/update dialogs block a fresh pane that has no hooks and no transcript yet, so the startup-quiet idle is the last word while the dialog waits. The startup-dialog rule reads the sustained approval screen and raises awaiting(approval), then clears when the dialog is gone. The unwitnessed pair correctly refuses to act on an approval screen throughout.
